stem.text: A child holds a thin metal wire that is attached to a kite. The graph shows how the extension of the wire varies with its tension.

stem.alt: Drawing of a child holding a wire, which runs up to a kite flying above and to the right. The wire is labelled wire and the kite is labelled kite.

Graph of tension /N against extension /mm, with tension from 0 to 150 N on the vertical axis and extension from 0 to 0.45 mm on the horizontal axis. A straight line starts at the origin and rises to the upper right, with dashed guide lines to the axes at 0.15, 0.30 and 0.45 mm and at 50, 100 and 150 N.

stem.text: A gust of wind increases the tension from $100\,\text{N}$ to $150\,\text{N}$.
What is the change in the elastic potential energy of the wire caused by the gust of wind?
